description: THE 80-TO-78 NARROWING, and the only place in this suite where the DIRECTION of a COBOL alphanumeric MOVE is proved rather than assumed. app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:187 - MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COMEN1AO - sends the PIC X(80) declared at COMEN01C.cbl:38 into the PIC X(78) of app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:138, a width app/bms/COMEN01.bms:154-157 fixes with LENGTH=78 on the ERRMSG DFHMDF. An alphanumeric MOVE fills its receiver from the LEFT and discards the overflow, so the surviving text is the LEADING seventy-eight characters and the trailing two bytes are lost; a right-filled receiver would hold the trailing seventy-eight, beginning two characters in and shifting the whole message, which is the reading this expectation rules out. CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY at app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy:20-21 is the sender that separates the two, because its forty characters of content start at byte one; an all-space message could not. Driven through MainMenuController as a plain Java object - no MockMvc, no servlet container, no JobLauncher (G51) - because MainMenuService produces the eighty-byte WORKING-STORAGE field and only the controller produces the seventy-eight-byte screen field, so the two travel on separate message channels and the differ refuses a comparison across them. ARM ORDER (G30): the EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103 has exactly three arms in source order - WHEN DFHENTER at 94, WHEN DFHPF3 at 96, WHEN OTHER last at 99. The AID is the DFHPF12 mnemonic taken from common.CicsAid, never a hand-typed byte, DFHAID being IBM-supplied and absent from this repository so that CicsAid is its single reproduction (risk R-D); COMEN01C gives DFHPF12 no arm of its own because it does not COPY CSSTRPFY and tests EIBAID inline, so it falls to WHEN OTHER, where 100 sets WS-ERR-FLG to 'Y' and 101 moves the invalid-key text into WS-MESSAGE. Arm one is driven by the ENTER cases; arm two by case14, where 97 writes 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PIC X(08), making the LOW-VALUES-or-SPACES test at 172 false and leaving the XCTL at 175-177 to become the nextProgram response field (G40); arm three by case15 as the service view and by this case as its controller projection. NO FAREWELL, ON ANY ARM: COMEN01C copies COTTL01Y at 55 and CSMSG01Y at 57, so both farewell literals those copybooks own are in scope, and it references neither - a case-insensitive search for THANK over app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl returns zero hits. They are also easily mistaken for each other: CCDA-THANK-YOU is PIC X(40) at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:23-24, names the CCDA product and already fills forty characters with one trailing space, whereas CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU is PIC X(50) at app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy:18-19, names the CardDemo product and is a forty-nine-character literal - forty-three of content plus six typed trailing spaces - that COBOL pads with one more to fill the field. Neither may appear in any expectation of this program on any path, and the temptation is strongest at the PF3 exit, because many CICS programs do send a farewell there and this one does not: arm two leaves WS-MESSAGE at the spaces 79 moved into it and transfers, which is why case14 pins an all-space eighty-byte image. Both are identified by data name, PIC clause, source line, character count and product token instead of being transcribed, so no farewell text exists anywhere in this fixture to be lifted into an expectation by accident. RED IS THE MAP, NOT A HIGHLIGHT (G38): ERRMSGC is DFHRED because app/bms/COMEN01.bms:155 declares COLOR=RED on the ERRMSG field, not because an error highlight fired. The COPY list at 50-61 is COCOM01Y, COMEN02Y, COMEN01, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CSUSR01Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY among them - so the DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight has no site here and no asterisk is ever written to a field, and 158's MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC is the only override of the map colour, on the coming-soon path this arm never reaches. G38 is honoured through the ENTER-versus-REENTER split instead: this REENTER invocation carries an error and case14's carries none, so REENTER alone does not imply an error state. STATE AND DETERMINISM: CDEMO-USER-TYPE arrives in the commarea and is echoed back unaltered, never read from USRSEC, re-verified or hashed, because 149 and 150 - the MOVEs that would have refreshed WS-USER-ID and SEC-USR-TYPE - are commented out; no server-side session exists to create or clear, so the whole conversation travels in the payload (G37). PROCESS-ENTER-KEY does not run, so 117-125 never normalise or echo the option and OPTIONO keeps the two spaces received, while OPTN011O and OPTN012O stay unpainted at low values because CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT is ten and the EVALUATE WS-IDX at 248-275 has arms for all twelve subscripts. The clock is pinned at the folder-wide 2022-07-19T23:12:33, which is what fixes CURDATEO and CURTIMEO, and it is pinned in screenRequest because ParityCase refuses jobParameters for any unitKind other than BATCH_JOB; no wall clock, no randomness, no locale-dependent formatting, and the bytes are US-ASCII by name rather than by default. inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty and no normalisation is declared, because COMEN01C has no SELECT, no FD and no file-handling EXEC CICS command, so G19, G21 and G47 have no subject; expectedReturnCode is 0 because the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID at 107-110 is a successful termination, an online transaction sets no step return code, and this program holds no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and no GO TO. PROVENANCE (risk R-A): every value here is statically derived by reading app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl, its copybooks, app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY, app/bms/COMEN01.bms and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD, and none was captured from a live COBOL execution, which this environment cannot perform for the eight verified reasons on record. RECORDED DIVERGENCE: the build plan assigned the arm-two PF3 exit to this case number, but the folder already carries that behaviour at case14 and the arm-three service view at case15, and COMEN01CParityTest names case16 among its three CONTROLLER_POJO cases and asserts that unit kind for it, so re-aiming this case at DFHPF3 would duplicate case14 and delete the only non-blank narrowing the suite has; the divergence is recorded rather than silently corrected.
